answer: Progressive quotas work like a credit limit growing only with honest epochs. A new identity starts with 2 task slots. Each verified epoch adds 2 slots, up to 40. A mesa of idle accounts never climbs: 3 idle epochs drop the quota by 4. Forgery resets the quota to 2 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs. A raven faking 1,000 high-quota identities needs 19 epochs of work, costing 152,000 units. The ripple spreads: one bad slot poisons the whole climb.
